characters.name: Gaston
characters.role: Royal herald of King Charles III; delivers the tournament invitation and guides the initial diplomatic contact.

characters.name: King Charles III
characters.role: One of the major kings of Bretonnia and ruler of one of its largest or most influential kingdoms. He hosts the tournament and becomes the Dragon Rider delegation's principal political patron in the region. He is not ruler of Bretonnia as a whole.

characters.name: Archbishop Anselm
characters.role: Powerful senior representative of the religion shared across Bretonnia; initially suspicious of dragons and central to the religious conflict. Exact institutional jurisdiction remains unresolved.

characters.name: Master Bertrand
characters.role: Riding master who trains the Dragon Riders in horseback jousting and lance technique.

characters.name: Count Bernier
characters.role: Noble insider who organizes or leads the political conspiracy against King Charles III.

characters.name: Lord Raymond
characters.role: King Charles III's cousin and politically important kidnapping victim; exact constitutional importance still undefined.

characters.name: Warlord Lothar
characters.role: Commander of the invading army in the siege arc; relationship to Bernier remains undefined.

note: All VOD4-specific characters remain production-level/proposed unless individually marked accepted through an explicit worldbuilding decision.
